transfers.title: Transfers & Car Hire
transfers.h1: Getting you there when it counts.
transfers.lede: Three ways to get around on a golf trip. Tell us which you'd prefer in the quote form and we'll build it in.
transfers.p1: The most economical seamless option: point-to-point transfers between the airport, the hotel and each course, so nobody has to navigate unfamiliar roads or find parking. From six golfers up it is usually cheaper than hiring cars, typically €90 to €120 per person for a five-night trip based on eight golfers with clubs.
transfers.p2: The same trusted driver throughout your stay, handling airport transfers, daily trips to the course and the last-minute changes that happen on every golf trip, with local recommendations thrown in. The stress-free option for groups who want to switch off.
transfers.p3: For groups who prefer flexibility: we arrange hire cars with club-friendly boot space and you drive yourselves. More planning, more freedom, and the best way to reach the remoter courses we book.

faqs.title: FAQs
faqs.lede: The short version of what's included, how booking works and when to travel. Anything else, just ask.
items: What is included in a package?

Each itinerary is bespoke, but packages typically cover accommodation with breakfast, green fees on the courses listed, tee times confirmed in advance and concierge support throughout. Private transfers, flights, buggies, caddies and extras such as dinners, whisky tastings or cultural tours are added on request.
Can we change a package?
Yes, every package is a starting point. Swap courses, add nights, upgrade the hotel or bring non-golfers. Tell us in the comments box on the quote form.
Can you get us onto private or limited-access courses?

Often, yes. Through our industry relationships we can arrange access to courses with limited visitor play, including Real Valderrama and Real Sotogrande, Muirfield and the Old Course. Book in good time.
Private transfers or a driver-guide?

Private transfers give you point-to-point comfort. A driver-guide stays with the group all week, handles changes on the fly and adds local knowledge. Self-drive car hire is the third option. See our transfers page.
When is the best time to travel?
Scotland, Ireland and England: May to October. Spain: October to May. Morocco and the UAE: October to April. Within those windows, the shoulder months are quieter and better value.
How far ahead should we book?
Four to eight months for premium courses and the best hotels, especially for spring and autumn in Britain and Ireland and winter in Spain. We can often work with shorter notice, so ask.
Can non-golfers join?
Absolutely. We build dual itineraries with sightseeing, spa days and excursions alongside the golf, so everyone meets for dinner.
What skill level do we need?
Any. Our trips suit casual players and low handicappers alike, and we'll match the courses to the group.
Do you provide travel insurance?
We don't sell it, but we strongly recommend comprehensive cover that includes golf equipment, and we'll advise what to look for.
How do we book?
Send an enquiry through any form on the site. We'll reply with a proposal within 24 hours, refine it with you, then confirm with a deposit. The balance is due before travel.

about.title: About Us
about.lede: One Golf Travel is run by golfers based in Sotogrande, southern Spain, with roots in the UK. We book the trips we would take ourselves.
about.p1: We started One Golf Travel because the golf trips we were booking for friends kept turning into the trips they talked about for years. We know the courses because we play them, we know the hotels because we have stayed in them, and we know the transfer times because we have sat in the van.
about.p2: We are a member of the International Association of Golf Tour Operators and we work with the clubs, hotels and transport partners directly. That is what gets a group onto Valderrama on a Tuesday or into the Old Course ballot with the paperwork done.
about.p3: Our sister brand, Racket Breaks, does the same for padel in the south of Spain.
